policy: Exact artwork and identity traits must match. New artwork requires a verified anatomy profile before paid admission. Profiles define appearance and locomotion only; player attacks and defenses remain fully custom.

profiles.identity: Red/coral Uniturtle with long neck, silver curved horn, green-rimmed goggles, small red dorsal shell and broad swimming flippers. No hoof legs or wings. Moves on the floor with flipper pushes and low belly slides; can rear to spit water. Do not invent aerial flight.
Purple Unibranch, cream chest/muzzle, magenta mane and tail, yellow vine markings and headband, curled ivory horn, four hoof legs; no wings. Ground movement.
Golden-yellow Unifairy with orange swept mane, teal star chest marking, silver curved horn and two large peach-and-teal butterfly wings. Flies with tucked feet; no running.

Midnight-blue Elrond Unidragon with cyan segmented belly, white curled forehead horn, black side head spikes, long tail, four short clawed limbs and folded membrane wings which unfold for flight. Keep dragon anatomy, not a pony.
